verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that GlitchTip's built-in MCP server lets users browse issues and resolve them, so a resolve action exists. Teams are documented only as notification routing, not issue ownership. missing for 10: assigning an owner to an issue, ignore action, snooze action, automatic reopening of resolved issues on regression, UI-level triage documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
